we have designed two phase invariant VGAs for a 28GHz receiver, implemented in 8HP Bi-CMOS, that achieve 18dB gain, 4 GHz BW and IP1dB of -13dBm with 35mW power consumption.

the design of high frequency variable gain amplifiers (VGAs) that can provide phase invariance.
